body:
## 0.8.2 - 2026-11-13

- Remove the Related Content editor panel, relationship search and save behaviour, and related-content list column.
- Retain previously stored relationship metadata so the change is non-destructive.
- Tighten the CSS Errors header into a compact action row with a single-line scan summary.
- Refresh CSS findings automatically whenever the CSS Errors page is opened.
